notes: Big nights: when you go to a party or a dance (or throw one), the night plays as a few short scenes built around who's actually there. nights.py picks the beats (an opening, two middles, an ending) and fills in the people: {host_first}, {friend_first}, {crush_first}, {date_first}, {partner_first}, {rival_first}, {them_first} (whoever the scene is about), {a_first} and {b_first} (two people about to fight), {secret} (a real crush someone tells you about), {other_first}, {event}, {n} (how many people came). A choice's 'did' is how it reads in the recap at the end of the night. Choices with 'requires' only show when those people are there.

arrive.title: {event}
text: {host_first}'s place is packed. Music's shaking the windows, {n} people at least. {friend_first} spots you from the kitchen and waves you over.
You can hear {host_first}'s party from the street. Inside: {n} people, a speaker way too big for the room, and {friend_first} yelling your name.

choices.label: Post up by the snacks and people-watch.

host.title: Your party
text: People start showing up at your place. {n} so far, and the doorbell keeps going. {friend_first} has already taken over the music.
Your house, your party. {n} people in, someone's already in the fridge, and {friend_first} is giving a tour you didn't ask for.

choices.label: Let {friend_first} run the door. Hang out.
Guard the living room furniture.
ops: Nothing breaks. You have fun for roughly none of it.

getready_date.title: {event}
text: {date_first} shows up at your door looking like a whole different person. Your family insists on photos. All of them.
It's {event} night. {date_first} is on your porch, and somebody in your family is already holding up a phone.

choices.label: Do all the photos.
ops: Twenty photos later, you're out the door. Your mom will post at least six.

choices.label: Get out the door before it gets embarrassing.
ops: You grab {date_first}'s hand and bolt. Your family yells something about a curfew.

getready_group.title: {event}
text: Everybody's getting ready at {friend_first}'s. Someone's ironing a shirt at the last second and the playlist is already too loud.
{event} night. The group's crammed into {friend_first}'s room, three people sharing one mirror.

choices.label: Take the group photo.
ops: Somebody blinked. It's still the best photo of the year.

choices.label: Fix {friend_first}'s collar.
ops: "What would I do without you," {friend_first} says. A lot worse, probably.

talk.title: Who do you end up with?
text: It's loud and everyone's everywhere. You end up next to…
Half an hour in, you've got a drink in your hand and a choice of who to talk to.

game.title: Cups on the table
text: Somebody's set up cups on the ping-pong table. {them_first} points at you: "You and me. Let's go."
The ping-pong table has become a cup table. {them_first} is undefeated and says so, loudly. They want you next.

great: Last cup, no rim. The basement goes nuts. {them_first} wants a rematch immediately.
good: Close game. {them_first} takes it on the last cup, but people saw.
miss: You don't hit one. Not one. People will talk about it, affectionately.

choices.label: Be the ref.
ops: Every call you make is wrong, according to someone. You're having a great time.

dancefloor.title: The dance-off
text: The gym's dark and loud. The DJ starts a dance-off circle, and {friend_first} shoves you toward it.
Somebody yells DANCE-OFF and a circle opens up in the middle of the floor. Everyone's looking at you.

choices.label: Jump in the circle.
choices.hint: you play it: hit the beat

great: You hit every beat. The circle loses it. Someone filmed it, and that's fine.
good: Not bad at all. People cheer and the circle moves on.
held your own in the dance-off
miss: You're completely off the beat. You commit anyway. Honestly? Respect.
went for it in the dance-off

slow.title: Slow song
text: The lights drop. Slow song. Couples drift onto the floor and everyone else suddenly needs water.
The DJ slows it down. The whole gym rearranges itself in about four seconds.

choices.label: Sit this one out.
ops: You and a few others hold down the bleachers. It's fine. It's fine.

porch.title: Out on the porch
text: {crush_first} is out on the porch by themselves, scrolling their phone.
You step outside for air. {crush_first} is already out there, sitting on the steps.

choices.label: Text them from inside.
ops: lol are you hiding out there
You watch {crush_first} read it and smile. Then look around for you.

fight.title: It's about to go down
text: {a_first} and {b_first} are squaring up by the pool table. People are already pulling out phones.
Voices get loud in the kitchen. {a_first} shoves {b_first}, and the whole party turns around.

choices.label: Step in.
ops: You get between them and somehow it works. Half the party saw you do it.
{a_first} shoves you out of the way. Nobody's hurt, but your pride is.
got shoved trying to stop a fight

choices.label: Film it.
ops: Your video is in every group chat by midnight. {a_first} and {b_first} are not fans.

choices.label: Get out of the way.
ops: You and {friend_first} end up on the stairs with a perfect view and zero involvement.
choices.did: watched a fight from the stairs

beef.title: {rival_first}
text: {rival_first} bumps you on purpose on the way past. "Watch where you're going."
{rival_first} is here. Of course {rival_first} is here. They make a comment loud enough for you to hear.

choices.label: Laugh it off.
ops: You laugh. People around you laugh. {rival_first} hates that more than anything.

choices.label: Get in their face.
ops: getting into it at a party
It gets loud, then physical, then somebody's parent is on the phone.

secret.title: You can't say anything
text: {them_first} pulls you into the hallway. "Okay. You can't say anything. {secret}"
{them_first} leans in way too close. "Swear you won't tell. {secret}"

jealous.title: {partner_first}
text: {partner_first} has been talking to {other_first} by the speaker for a while now. Like, a while.
Every time you look over, {partner_first} is laughing at something {other_first} said.

busted.title: Cops
text: Somebody yells from the front window: "COPS!" The music cuts and everyone moves at once.
Red and blue lights through the curtains. Forty people try to leave through one back door.

choices.label: Bolt out the back.
ops: Over the fence, through two backyards, home free. Your heart doesn't slow down until you're in bed.
being at a party the cops broke up
You get caught on the fence. An officer takes your name. Your parents will hear about this.

choices.label: Stay calm. Act normal.
ops: You stand there looking extremely innocent. It works.
talked your way out of the bust
being at a party the cops broke up
Your parents get a call. Acting normal wasn't the move.

choices.label: Help {host_first} hide everything.
ops: You and {host_first} get everything hidden in four minutes flat. {host_first} owes you forever.
being at a party the cops broke up
You're still holding a trash bag when they walk in. {host_first} owes you forever, for what it's worth.

end.title: End of the night
text: It's late. Phones are dying and the place is thinning out. Some people are heading to {after_first}'s.
Last song. Lights on. Somebody's already planning the after-party at {after_first}'s.

choices.label: Get a ride home with {friend_first}.
ops: You and {friend_first} sit in the driveway for twenty minutes replaying the whole night.

great: You end up talking for an hour about everything. Then {them_first} leans in, and you're kissing on {host_first}'s porch steps.
good: Somehow an hour goes by. When you finally go back inside, people definitely noticed you two were gone.
bad: It's awkward. You both look at your phones. {them_first} says they should find their friends.

great: {them_first} takes your hand before you finish asking. Halfway through the song, they lean in and kiss you.
good: "Yeah, okay," {them_first} says, smiling. You dance. Your hands don't know where to go. It's perfect.
bad: "Oh, um. I'm good, thanks." {them_first} heads back to their friends. You walk very calmly to the water fountain.

great: The song ends and neither of you lets go. {them_first} kisses you right there in the middle of the gym.
good: {them_first} rests their head on your shoulder for the whole song. You'll think about it all week.
bad: You step on {them_first}'s foot. Twice. They laugh it off, mostly.

great: You take the long way. At {them_first}'s door, they kiss you goodnight and go inside grinning.
good: The long way home, talking about nothing. "Text me when you're home," {them_first} says.
bad: The walk is mostly quiet. "Thanks," {them_first} says at the door. Just thanks.

great: At the door, {them_first} kisses you goodnight. You walk back to the car like you're floating.
good: "Tonight was really fun," {them_first} says, and hugs you for a long time.
bad: A quick hug and they're inside. Something felt off tonight.
